Jasmine P: Quick question Candidate for Senior Infra (UK) - manager requesting comp band uplift + gross-up on GBP 10k sign-on. Thoughts on approvals + payroll implications? cc @Tess H @Carlos F
Tess H: Manager here. Candidate expects band 6 base; we're at band 5 budget. Offering sign-on GBP 10k and requests gross-up to cover tax if we pay cash. Wants start ASAP, ideally in 2 weeks (mid-pay-cycle).
Carlos F: Gross-ups for UK hires are uncommon. They create taxable benefit and employer NI liabilities. We can either: 1) refuse gross-up and offer net amount via umbrella (messy), 2) reclass as relocation/stipend paid after 60 days, or 3) pay gross but not gross-up and document. Finance prefers option 2.
Priya S: Candidate is open to relocation stipend wording but asked if stipend can be paid on day 1. Manager says no, needs early productivity.
Carlos F: If start mid-cycle, payroll will prorate and taxes calculated on first pay run. Paying stipend day 1 increases withholding complexity. Recommend pay base from first payroll, stipend at 60 days.
Liam G: From people-ops perspective, band uplift needs comp-committee approval. I can provisionally sign off on a temporary band 6 offer if manager agrees to sign-ons being handled per finance rec. Jasmine, please submit comp-exception with clear retention rationale.
Jasmine P: Will open exception. What docs do we need? I'll attach scorecard, offer letter draft, manager justification, and finance note. Also add candidate consent for relocation language.
Tess H: I'll get the scorecard and manager note uploaded. Candidate prefers earlier date; any flexibility on paying a portion upfront (e.g., GBP 2k on day 1, rest at 60d)?
Carlos F: Partial upfront OK if below GBP 2,000 and classified as 'onboarding stipend'. Anything >2k pushes more reporting. If partial, we'll cap day-1 at 2k and remainder at 60d. Still no gross-up.
legal-bot: Legal review requested for thread 2476510011. Assigned to @legal-team-uk. Note: review for stipend classification and pay timing. Est. 48-72 hrs.
Liam G: Sounds like a path forward. Jasmine, route to comp-committee + finance + legal. If comp committee approves band uplift, we'll finalize offer with prorated start payroll notes and stipend schedule.
Jasmine P: Routing now. Summary: "Request band uplift 5->6 for Senior Infra; sign-on structured as onboarding/relocation stipend with up to GBP 2k day-1 and remainder at 60d; no gross-up; payroll start mid-cycle acceptable with prorated pay." Attaching docs.
Tess H: Thanks all. I'll update candidate and confirm whether they accept the partial upfront option.
Priya S: I'll track and follow up on comp-committee. Will post outcome here. :mag:
